office.title: U.S. Representative
office.summary: Members of the U.S. House of Representatives write and vote on federal laws, including the federal budget and taxes. Each represents one congressional district for a two-year term; Indiana has nine {house_explained}.
duties: Introduces bills and resolutions, offers amendments, and votes on legislation; federal laws must pass both the House and the Senate {house_explained}.
Serves on committees, which draft legislation in their subject areas and oversee federal agencies and programs {house_explained}.
Must be at least 25, a U.S. citizen for at least seven years, and live in the state they represent {house_explained}.
